title: TTY canonical reads apply the noncanonical VMIN threshold
mechanism: LineDiscipline::try_read compares the buffered byte count with min(len, VMIN) before it looks at the mode, so a completed canonical line shorter than VMIN yields EAGAIN (nonblocking) or keeps Tty::read waiting (blocking).
contract: termios(3): in canonical mode input is available line by line, and VMIN/VTIME apply only to noncanonical reads, so a completed line is returned regardless of VMIN.
observed: By source reading at the pin (not run): a canonical read of a completed 2-byte line with VMIN=5 returns EAGAIN on a nonblocking PTY slave and waits on a blocking one.

repro.how_to_run: Run `make static` in repro/ on x86-64 Linux, copy bin/abi_probe into an Asterinas guest, and run `abi_probe <case>` for tty_canonical_vmin. repro/README.md gives the saved Linux output.

caveats: SOURCE LEAD, Asterinas NOT_RUN. Separate from AST-56 (VTIME timeout). Only matters when VMIN exceeds the completed line length. Legacy text-only probe.
